stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: Anthropic will design its own hardware to power Claude
stories.author: Samuel Axon
bullet_points: Anthropic is developing proprietary hardware to support its Claude AI models.
This move signals a strategic effort by major AI labs to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.
The development is part of a broader industry race to achieve massive AI scaling.

stories.title: Large genome models used to design new viruses
stories.author: John Timmer
bullet_points: Large genome models are being utilized to engineer novel viruses.
The AI system is capable of generating genetically diverse, bacteria-killing viral variants.
This represents a significant application of AI in synthetic biology and virology.

stories.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon
stories.author: itvision
bullet_points: AMD has acquired Taalas to enhance its capabilities in AI inference performance.
The core technology involves 'etching models in silicon,' suggesting hardware-level optimization for AI workloads.
This acquisition targets the rapidly expanding market for AI inference, positioning AMD competitively in the AI hardware space.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text generation tasks, indicating its function as a generative AI.
Key associated technologies include transformers and safetensors, standard components in modern NLP/LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary application.
The associated tags (transformers, llama, safetensors) confirm its relevance to modern NLP and LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million in a funding round.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent performance saw up to a 90% speed increase according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It integrates native support with Ollama, facilitating the use of local LLMs.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance enhancement.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, optimizing local AI inference.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging applications with local AI coding agents.
The core feature emphasizes running AI processes entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT free users unlimited text chats
stories.author: Jay Peters
bullet_points: OpenAI is removing rate limits for text chats on free and Go tiers of ChatGPT.
This change significantly improves the usability and accessibility of ChatGPT for non-paying users.
The update is scheduled to roll out starting next week.

stories.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
stories.author: Zhijie Deng
bullet_points: Argus is introduced as a general-purpose agentic runtime designed for complex, long-horizon reasoning tasks.
The runtime features distinct components (Manager, Planner, Engineer, Reviewer) that operate over a durable project state.
It addresses the need for persistence and adaptability, allowing agents to maintain a course or pivot based on new evidence and constraints.

stories.title: FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India
stories.author: Jigar Doshi
bullet_points: Introduces FormBharo, a voice agent designed to automate conversational form filling in rural India.
Addresses a critical societal problem where illiterate populations need access to social benefits requiring form submission.
Achieves this by integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) while adhering to strict latency and cost constraints.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces improved performance and expanded GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to enhance model support across diverse hardware setups.
It augments Ollama's existing MLX engine, specifically benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for supporting long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: OpenAI is collaborating with Jony Ive on a new AI gadget.
The device is described as a battery-powered, doughnut-shaped smart speaker without a display.
It is anticipated to launch in 2027 with a price point exceeding $300.

stories.title: Suno shares plans to combat spammy AI music
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Suno is introducing watermarking technology to combat the spread of spammy AI-generated music.
The company is also implementing a new download policy aimed at increasing transparency regarding AI tracks.
The move reflects Suno's efforts to establish legitimacy and address misuse within the rapidly evolving AI music space.

stories.title: Brendan Carr officially unleashes broadcast consolidation
stories.author: Lauren Feiner
bullet_points: The FCC has voted to eliminate the national broadcast ownership cap rule.
This decision, driven by FCC Republicans Chair Brendan Carr and Commissioner Olivia Trusty, ends limits on how many stations one entity can own.
The change signifies a major shift in broadcast media ownership structure.

stories.title: Suno hopes to go legit with watermarks for AI-generated music
stories.author: Ryan Whitwam
bullet_points: Suno, an AI music generator, is implementing watermarking technology.
The measure is intended to combat 'large-scale abuse' of the AI tool.
Download limits are also part of Suno's strategy to regulate usage.

stories.title: Blue Origin narrowing in on root cause of catastrophic rocket accident
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Blue Origin is investigating the cause of a recent catastrophic rocket accident.
The investigation has narrowed the anomaly to the main oxygen valve on a BE-4 engine.
This points to a specific hardware failure as the likely root cause.

stories.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
stories.author: Iryna Gurevych
bullet_points: Introduces OctoLong, a new context engineering pipeline designed to improve long-context modeling in Language Models (LMs).
Addresses the limitation of existing long-context corpora, which are often scarce in capturing long-distance dependencies, especially in code.
OctoLong integrates an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager to instrument code contexts during training.

stories.title: Teaching Nemotron Greek: Mining a Corpus, Adapting Retrieval, and Grounding Generation for Modern Greek across Specialist Domains
stories.author: Christos Petrocheilos
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in large language model capabilities by adapting NVIDIA's Nemotron retrieval stack for Modern Greek.
The research tackles the lack of Modern Greek support in major multilingual retrieval benchmarks, crucial for specialized domains.
Introduces a comprehensive methodology including corpus mining, synthetic supervision, and a new benchmark named HERA.

stories.title: OPD-V: Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation with Modality Balance
stories.author: Tat-Seng Chua
bullet_points: Introduces OPD-V, a new method for Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation in MLLMs.
Addresses the critical issue of Modality Imbalance, where text often dominates multimodal reasoning.
Aims to improve visual reasoning in MLLMs by balancing the integration of diverse input modalities.

stories.title: SSTQ:Privacy-Preserving Vector Quantization via Subsampled Stochastic TurboQuant
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Introduces SSTQ, a new framework for privacy-preserving vector quantization.
Addresses the challenge of achieving local differential privacy in distributed optimization with low communication cost.
Combines overcomplete tight frames, coordinate subsampling, and privacy-aware 1D quantization to reduce variance.

stories.title: Chained Recursive Language Models for Multi-Iteration Reasoning
stories.author: Sennur Ulukus
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of single-inference trajectories in LLMs for complex reasoning tasks.
Proposes 'Chained Recursive Language Models' (Chained RLM) to handle multi-iteration reasoning.
Aims to mitigate error propagation in tasks requiring extraction, counting, or multi-hop logic.

stories.title: CoPlan: A Trustworthy Co-Intelligence Interface for Care Planning through Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs
stories.author: Hung Cao
bullet_points: Introduces CoPlan, a new interface designed for trustworthy co-intelligence in healthcare planning.
Addresses a key limitation in current AI systems where recommendations are presented as fixed outputs, hindering human oversight.
Utilizes Role-Based Contestable Argument Graphs to allow stakeholders (clinicians, patients, etc.) to inspect and challenge AI-generated care plans.

stories.title: ABSeeker: Training Long-Horizon Search Agents via Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment
stories.author: Siheng Chen
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of training long-horizon search agents, which require many sequential steps to find an answer.
Proposes Answer-Backtracked Credit Assignment (ABC) to provide fine-grained credit assignment during training.
ABC aims to differentiate between useful, erroneous, or redundant actions within a search trajectory, improving RL/SFT efficiency.

stories.title: Improving the Realism of Synthetic Clinical Benchmarks Under Utility Constraints
stories.author: Christine Swisher
bullet_points: Addresses the gap where synthetic clinical benchmarks, while passing utility tests, can be structurally unrealistic.
Proposes a methodology to improve the realism of these synthetic datasets while adhering to existing operational utility constraints.
Focuses on a critical need in privacy-sensitive healthcare AI development where real data access is limited.

stories.title: RxnCLF: Contrastive Transformation-Aware Reaction Foundation Model for Improved Reactivity Prediction
stories.author: Haote Li
bullet_points: Introduces RxnCLF, a new foundation model utilizing contrastive learning for chemical reaction prediction.
Addresses the challenge of scarce labeled data and the vast, sparse nature of chemical reaction space.
Aims to improve reactivity prediction by moving beyond traditional string, fingerprint, and graph-based encodings.

stories.title: MetaboLLM: a metabolomics-specialized large language model for biochemical knowledge integration and predictive metabolite graph construction
stories.author: Jing Li
bullet_points: Introduction of MetaboLLM, a specialized Large Language Model designed for metabolomics data.
The model utilizes continual pretraining, fine-tuning, and structured retrieval to integrate complex biochemical knowledge.
It integrates with MetaboLLM-GIN to convert textual descriptions into metabolite graphs for patient-level prediction.

stories.title: A Six-Dimensional Taxonomy of Post-Training Adaptation Techniques with Applications in AI Governance
stories.author: Farhad Abtahi
bullet_points: The paper proposes a six-dimensional taxonomy to organize the diverse field of post-training adaptation techniques in ML.
It addresses the current fragmentation in the literature across technique families, model types, and deployment scenarios.
The survey covers a wide range of methods, including fine-tuning, parameter-efficient adaptation, model editing, and unlearning.

stories.title: Timestep-Conditioned Transformers for Global Weather Forecasting
stories.author: Viktor Cikojevic
bullet_points: The research addresses a core limitation in current weather forecasting ML models: the fixed nature of autoregressive timesteps.
The study proposes using Timestep-Conditioned Transformers to dynamically handle the trade-off between fine-grained short-term resolution and long-term error accumulation.
This work is relevant to improving the accuracy and usability of global weather prediction systems by optimizing temporal modeling.

stories.title: TS-RAG: Retrieval Augmented Generation for Time Series Forecasting
stories.author: Jingbo Zhou
bullet_points: Proposes TS-RAG, applying Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to Time Series Forecasting.
Addresses the limitation of current deep learning models in time series by integrating external sequence retrieval.
Suggests that retrieving similar time series sequences can enhance the accuracy of forecasting models.

stories.title: Schema-Guided Hierarchical Information Extraction and Semantic Evaluation Using Generative AI
stories.author: Lourens T. Bloem
bullet_points: Introduces a schema-based framework for extracting complex, structured information from unstructured text.
Leverages Generative AI to perform information extraction, guided by a domain-specific schema.
Includes an automated semantic evaluation component to validate extracted data against a gold standard.

stories.title: Decolonizing Linguistic Policies in Automated Speech Recognition: A Framework for Cross-Culturally Competent Speech AI
stories.author: Efi Dawodu
bullet_points: The research addresses systemic biases in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems that disproportionately affect low-resource and Indigenous language varieties.
It frames ASR failures not merely as technical bugs, but as manifestations of implicit colonial linguistic policies.
The paper proposes a decolonial computing framework to build more cross-culturally competent speech AI for critical public services.

stories.title: Poli-Bias: Understanding and Measuring Large Language Model Biases in International Political Conflicts
stories.author: Holger Boche
bullet_points: Introduces 'Poli-Bias,' a new counterfactual framework to measure political bias in Large Language Models (LLMs).
Addresses the difficulty of measuring subtle biases in LLMs, such as differences in framing or legal reasoning.
The framework specifically tests if LLMs treat legally equivalent international conflict scenarios differently based on country identity.

stories.title: Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers
stories.author: Mihai Surdeanu
bullet_points: Introduces Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings (SiPE) to augment standard Transformer positional encodings.
SiPE integrates a lightweight syntactic prior, derived from dependency parses, into existing PE families (absolute, relative, rotary).
The method is designed to enhance model understanding by incorporating syntactic structure without altering the core self-attention mechanism.

stories.title: From Siloed Algorithms to Compliance-First Agentic Platforms: A Multi-Layered Architecture for Hospital AI Systems
stories.author: Sharat Chandra Kumar Manikonda
bullet_points: Current hospital AI deployments are often isolated 'point solutions' leading to inefficiency and risk.
A major hurdle in healthcare AI adoption is the failure to scale, attributed to governance and data fragmentation.
The research proposes a 'Compliance-First Agentic Platform' architecture to overcome these integration and governance gaps.

stories.title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
stories.author: Faik Boray Tek
bullet_points: Introduces ECHO, a locally-deployable agentic health assistant designed for chronic care management.
The system utilizes a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph and incorporates a temporal knowledge graph for persistent memory.
It is equipped with 17 clinical tools and demonstrates a high tool-execution pass rate (94.9%).

stories.title: Training-Free Token-Level Steering for LLM Personalized Co-Writing
stories.author: Hairong Lv
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of LLMs lacking specialized domain knowledge for personalization.
Proposes 'SteerWrit' to enable training-free, token-level steering, bypassing the high cost of fine-tuning.
Aims to advance LLM usage beyond simple chat interfaces into productive co-writing paradigms.

stories.title: LangChoiceBench: Measuring and Explaining Programming-Language Choice in LLMs
stories.author: Jie M. Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces LangChoiceBench, a new benchmark for evaluating LLM programming language choices.
Addresses the lack of systematic measurement for LLM language preferences, particularly Python bias.
Tests language diversity and recommendation consistency across 28 projects in diverse software areas.

stories.title: Inside vLLM: Anatomy of a High-Throughput LLM Inference System (2025)
stories.author: sebg
bullet_points: The article provides an in-depth technical breakdown of vLLM.
It focuses on the architecture enabling high-throughput Large Language Model (LLM) inference.
The topic is highly relevant to current advancements in efficient AI deployment.

stories.title: I Spent a Day With Kiro Crew. Here's What It Actually Does.
stories.author: sarvar_04
bullet_points: Demonstrates an AI agent capable of investigating P1 latency spikes.
The agent automates prevention setup and documents operational knowledge.
The solution is presented as highly cost-effective at $0.04 per incident.
